refined_nucleus: A thin, high-strength, and low-modulus polymer layer is embedded between the transducer array elements and the imaging electronics to absorb and distribute mechanical stress, while also incorporating a material with a high thermal conductivity to mitigate thermal stress.
new_relationship: The polymer layer interacts with the thermal material to mitigate thermal stress, creating a synergistic effect that enhances the overall performance of the device.
new_configuration: The thermal material is integrated into the polymer layer, creating a hybrid material that can absorb and distribute both mechanical and thermal stress.
new_control_rule: The control logic is modified to include a thermal stress threshold value, which is compared to the measured thermal stress to determine when to activate the polymer layer.
refined_structure: The device consists of a transducer array element, a hybrid polymer layer, a thermal material, and an imaging electronics module, arranged in a stacked configuration.
refined_causal_chain: step1: Measure mechanical stress on the transducer array element
step2: Measure thermal stress on the transducer array element
step3: Compare measured mechanical stress to threshold value
step4: Compare measured thermal stress to threshold value
step5: Activate polymer layer if stress exceeds threshold
step6: Activate thermal material if thermal stress exceeds threshold
